{{Quote|Agent Ottau, Republic SIS. Welcome to Ord Mantell. Hope you enjoy war zones, Master Jedi. This planet's full of them.|Ottau|<ref name="New Intelligence" />}}
'''Ottau''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] tasked Ottau with tracing a transmission from the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]], which Ottau tracked to a [[Imperial Listening Post|secret Imperial listening post]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Ottau then passed on his reconnaissance to a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] sent by Suthra, and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Desolator crisis)|attacked]] the listening post, recovering valuable data.

==Biography==
{{Quote|General Var Suthra had me send a probe droid to the hyperspace data transceiver's location. I learned two things. First, it's on an island. Second, they don't like visitors there. My probe droid wound up disintegrated. Make sure that doesn't happen to you, eh?|Ottau|<ref name="New Intelligence" />}}
Ottau worked as an [[Agent/Legends|agent]] for the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] intelligence agency, during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="New Intelligence" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]] attempted to use the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] against the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and he contacted his [[Parent/Legends|father]], the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Angral]], via a long-range [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] transmission. Tarnis was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] before he could use the Planet Prison, prompting Angral to declare a [[Desolator crisis|personal war]] against the Republic as a result.<ref name="Race to the Ruins">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Race to the Ruins|Coruscant}}</ref> In order to determine Angral's plans, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] sent Agent Ottau to trace Tarnis's transmission back to its source.<ref name="New Intelligence" />

[[File:Secluded_Island_Facility.png|thumb|left|200px|The Imperial listening post]]
Ottau soon identified the origin of the transmission as an [[Imperial Listening Post|Imperial listening post]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] and attempted to investigate the facility on Suthra's orders&mdash;but the [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] he sent to the island facility was quickly destroyed by the Imperials stationed there. Retreating to the Republic [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] of [[Fort Garnik]] to the south of the target, he awaited the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] sent by Suthra to investigate the facility. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]&mdash;the same Knight who had [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|killed Tarnis]]&mdash;brought along the [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] to meet with Ottau, who gave the pair an estimate of the base's defenses. The duo [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Desolator crisis)|assaulted the listening post]] and were successful in accessing the facility's [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|hyperspace transceiver]], from which T7-O1 downloaded information on Angral's plans. The Knight and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|droid]] then returned to Ottau and informed him of the mission's success, and the agent began gathering a team to secure the now undefended listening post for the Republic.<ref name="New Intelligence" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Personally, I prefer life in the shadows. It lasts longer.|Ottau|<ref name="New Intelligence" />}}
A tan-skinned [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="Jedipedia" />  Ottau had long, [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Ottau was trained as a covert agent and preferred intelligence gathering to combat, and he disliked using [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weaponry.<ref name="New Intelligence" />

==Equipment==
During his time on Ord Mantell, Ottau disguised himself as a settler, wearing clothing common to other residents of Fort Garnik.<ref name="New Intelligence" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ottau appears in the Jedi Knight-class mission "New Intelligence" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="New Intelligence" />
